rationale: The replication successfully reproduces all seven quantitative checks of the paper's minimal tight-binding model for altermagnetic spin splitting. The numeric 4×4 Hamiltonian diagonalization matches the analytic Eq.(3) to machine precision, the momentum-dependent splitting requires both δt≠0 and h_eff≠0 as claimed, and the d-wave nodal structure with nodes along kx=0/ky=0 is confirmed. Coverage is 7/10 because the DFT validation on MnF₂ and SOC/AHE topology extensions were deliberately out of scope, but the core theoretical model claims are fully verified with perfect agreement.
